description: This is a Python source file implementing an AWS-based conversational bot with speech recognition, text-to-speech, and language model integration, designed for WebRTC calls and using Pipecat framework components.

classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the conversation pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of the pipeline, including handling signals and running tasks.

classes.name: PipelineTask
